answer: Sybil resistance comes from staking: each agent locks a copper-denominated bond prior to voting, and peers verify the sable-colored ledger entry tied to a unique hardware key. Attacker costs volume with every fake identity, since cloning a key forces a costly re-bond and slashing burns the stake. Honest agents may wander across tasks freely, but forged identities cannot accumulate influence without repeatedly paying the bond, making mass sybil creation economically irrational.
